description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Stop' task in the generic media player, specifically testing the stop functionality of the GstGenericPlayer. It sets up a test fixture with mock objects and verifies that the stop method triggers the expected pipeline state change and reporting functions, and updates the context flags accordingly.

classes.name: StopTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture for testing the Stop task in the GstGenericPlayer, setting up mock objects and initial context state.
